propositions: Bugs currently short-circuit plan-review gate to bare exempt-PASS with no substantive review (verified on bug 5886: runner=exempt, llm_calls=0)
No criterion exists to detect over-action (change adds mechanism without establishing need); FixedBench shows 35-65% unnecessary changes
New advisory criterion `necessity` must flag plans lacking reproduction/motivation, accept justified no-op/docs-only outcomes, apply to bugs (no suppress_types)
Bug review tier must run DET floor + necessity probe only (no full suite), downgrade all findings to advisory, never block a bug
Advisory criteria `necessity` and bug tier must be registered non-orphan in CANONICAL_LLM and BUG_TIER_CRITERIA, auto-monitored by standing recorder for promotion to blocking
Both pieces ship advisory-only and require bounded sanity validation (<=8 live runs, not E2/E3 batch) before promotion-gate decision on effectiveness metrics
